Support official DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` while retaining `0.2.0-rc.2` compatibility.

Admit `0.2.1-rc.2` in the declared `peerDependencies` and `engines.dsh` ranges (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || 0.2.1-rc.2`). No runtime code changes were required for the session, agent, or client workspace interfaces used by this plugin.

在声明的 `peerDependencies` 与 `engines.dsh` 兼容范围（`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || 0.2.1-rc.2`）中显式纳入官方 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`，同时保留对 `0.2.0-rc.2` 的支持。

Validation: 33 automated tests, release-tool and npm package verification, and isolated official DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2` fresh-boot and restart acceptance checks (live/cold edits, retained image blocks, sibling retries, nested branches, and persisted branch recovery) with an offline model. User-message image rendering on DSH 0.2 remains tracked separately in [#9](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/issues/9).

Install from npm or the attached release archive:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-message-edit
```

Restart DSH after updating.
